source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT (SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Get_HR_Core_Common_Updates_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'Refresh WF_People' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Refresh_WF_People') AS Get_HR_Core_Common_Updates_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Get_HR_Core_Common_Updates_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'Refresh WF_People' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Refresh_WF_People') AS Get_HR_Core_Common_Updates_TableName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_ContainerName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'Refresh WF_People' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Refresh_WF_People') AS OLE_DB_Destination_ContainerName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_FileName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'Refresh WF_People' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Refresh_WF_People') AS OLE_DB_Destination_FileName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_FilePath' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'Refresh WF_People' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Refresh_WF_People') AS OLE_DB_Destination_FilePath,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Refresh_WF_People01_source_ContainerName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'Refresh WF_People' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Refresh_WF_People01') AS Refresh_WF_People01_source_ContainerName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Refresh_WF_People01_source_FileName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'Refresh WF_People' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Refresh_WF_People01') AS Refresh_WF_People01_source_FileName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Refresh_WF_People01_source_FilePath' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'Refresh WF_People' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Refresh_WF_People01') AS Refresh_WF_People01_source_FilePath,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Refresh_WF_People01_sink_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'Refresh WF_People' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Refresh_WF_People01') AS Refresh_WF_People01_sink_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Refresh_WF_People01_sink_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'Refresh WF_People' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Refresh_WF_People01') AS Refresh_WF_People01_sink_TableName;

scripts.text: SELECT FORMAT(MAX(update_date), 'yyyyMMdd') AS lastRefreshDateString FROM dbo.WF_People

source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT to_number(EMPLID) EMPLID     , PREF_FIRST_NAME || ' ' || PREF_LAST_NAME NAME     , PREF_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME     , PREF_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME     , EMAIL_ID     	TCOO Flag 		 00002115460 > Tiago Spritzer 		 00001672258 > Shan Ramanathan     , CASE 			WHEN (SPRVS_ORG_LVL_03_MGR_ID = '00002115460' OR SPRVS_ORG_LVL_06_MGR_ID = '00001672258') THEN 1 			ELSE 0  			END IS_TCOO         	Platform App Services Team Flag			 			 00002086646 > Rob Okai 			 00002117751 > Satish Ambale 	, CASE 			WHEN (SPRVS_ORG_LVL_04_MGR_ID = '00002086646' OR SPRVS_ORG_LVL_07_MGR_ID = '00002117751') THEN 1 			ELSE 0  			END IS_PLATFORM_APP_SVCS     , SPRVS_ORG_LVL_03_NAME     , SPRVS_ORG_LVL_03_MGR_NAME     , CASE      	WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(SPRVS_ORG_LVL_03_MGR_ID, '^[[:digit:]]+$')     	THEN to_number(SPRVS_ORG_LVL_03_MGR_ID)      	ELSE NULL     	END SPRVS_ORG_LVL_03_MGR_ID     , SPRVS_ORG_LVL_04_NAME     , SPRVS_ORG_LVL_04_MGR_NAME     , CASE      	WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(SPRVS_ORG_LVL_04_MGR_ID, '^[[:digit:]]+$')     	THEN to_number(SPRVS_ORG_LVL_04_MGR_ID)      	ELSE NULL     	END SPRVS_ORG_LVL_04_MGR_ID     , EMPL_STATUS     , EMPL_STATUS_DESC  FROM DISTRIBUTION.VW_CORE_COMMON WHERE WHEN_CHANGED >= TO_DATE('', 'YYYYMMDD')
